pillar_reactions.evidence: Accepted the pillar ('yes, that training and the mobility is what I'm looking for? Yes') but immediately asked about workload and scheduling: 'my schedule, it's pretty open. I would like to see how much, like, work Trevor and your team would work on, but no, I'm perfectly able to work out.'

Rep laid out whole foods, maintenance calories and an eating window, then asked 'Do you feel like, yes, that is something I want and that's also something I see myself doing?' Answer: 'Yes, yeah.' No questions, no pushback.

Tied the teach-a-man-to-fish pillar straight to his own situation, unprompted: 'Doing after six months and thinking all the knowledge in my brain, like the kettlebells and workouts and diets, you know, it's something that's going to stick with me. So it's, you know, it's not just doing something for six months and then stopping it.'

anchors.raw: because we have money, like, we're getting married, something soon. So, all the money has to be. You know, available.
anchors.note: An imminent wedding is the number already in his head when $6,000 lands, and it is jointly held with the person whose approval he needs. This is why the price landed as a cashflow problem rather than a value problem.

anchors.raw: I have a thousand available and that's like the money I can make every week, you know, with my, with my, my, job.
anchors.note: Roughly $1,000 a week self-reported. $6,000 is six weeks of gross earnings, which puts him well outside the 'makes good money, price is a quality signal' profile the offer is priced for.

anchors.raw: I saw a video of him saying like he had, he was like in the hospital, and I saw his shoulder or something like that, and that was maybe interesting to me too, that was like maybe he has a little bit of tips or something like that.
anchors.note: He arrived pre-sold on Trevor specifically and on Trevor's own shoulder-injury story. The rep leaned on this ('Trevor himself also had a few accidents'), which is the strongest supportive anchor on the call and the reason there was zero value resistance.

unmet_demand.want: To find out what is actually wrong with his shoulder - 'I'm trying to figure out maybe if it's my, you know, um, rotator cuff or like my scapula' - and have it fixed
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme is coaching, not clinical assessment; nobody can diagnose an eight-month shoulder complaint and the rep neither referred him out nor asked whether a clinician had looked at it. He was instead told the shoulder would get better through the programme.

unmet_demand.want: Meaningful direct access to Trevor himself, which is what drew him in
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Partly served and clearly answered - 'the coaching is all going to be one-on-one with Trevor' - but he had already voiced doubt that a person with a million followers could realistically be reachable, and nothing was shown to substantiate the claim.
